name: The Hill / frat row on College Ave
c01_spawn_note: C01's 'hill' object (threshold at 34, 392) should use spawn [880, 340] (just inside H01's east exit).

objects.name: Front door / the party
objects.suggested: The door is propped open with a shoe. The bass comes out before the light does.

objects.name: Couch on the lawn
objects.suggested: A plaid couch on the lawn, facing the street like it has front-row tickets. The middle cushion is missing.
lines: A plaid couch on the lawn, facing the street like it has front-row tickets. The middle cushion is missing.

objects.name: Brick house / GAMMA THETA XI
objects.suggested: Brass letters, porch light on, blinds down. This house is having a quiet night, loudly.
lines: Brass letters, porch light on, blinds down. This house is having a quiet night, loudly.

objects.name: Bedsheet banner
objects.suggested: A bedsheet banner: RUSH WEEK / ALL WELCOME. The paint dripped. Nobody minded.
lines: A bedsheet banner: RUSH WEEK / ALL WELCOME. The paint dripped. Nobody minded.

objects.name: Porch roof / lawn chairs and a flamingo
objects.suggested: Two lawn chairs and a plastic flamingo on the porch roof. The flamingo has the best seat on the Hill.
lines: Two lawn chairs and a plastic flamingo on the porch roof. The flamingo has the best seat on the Hill.

objects.name: Tudor house / PHI XI PI
objects.suggested: Two pumpkins on the steps. One has the house letters carved in. One letter is just a hole.
lines: Two pumpkins on the steps. One has the house letters carved in. One letter is just a hole.

objects.name: NO PARKING ON LAWN
objects.suggested: NO PARKING ON LAWN. Underneath, smaller: COUCHES OK.
lines: NO PARKING ON LAWN. Underneath, smaller: COUCHES OK.

objects.name: Cornhole boards
objects.suggested: Three bean bags, all short. The game was abandoned at 20 to 19.
lines: Three bean bags, all short. The game was abandoned at 20 to 19.

objects.name: Recycling bin
objects.suggested: The recycling bin is mostly red cups, stacked like a trophy.
lines: The recycling bin is mostly red cups, stacked like a trophy.

objects.name: Scooter on its side
objects.suggested: A rental scooter lying on the sidewalk. It has seen things tonight.
lines: A rental scooter lying on the sidewalk. It has seen things tonight.

objects.name: Parked hatchback
objects.suggested: A hatchback with a parking ticket and a CU parking sticker from three years ago.
lines: A hatchback with a parking ticket and a CU parking sticker from three years ago.

objects.name: COLLEGE AVE
objects.suggested: COLLEGE AVE. Downhill is campus. Uphill is every bad idea in Boulder.
lines: COLLEGE AVE. Downhill is campus. Uphill is every bad idea in Boulder.

objects.name: Tanner / the rush chair (mini-boss)
objects.note: Clear stage for the couch entrance: the street from x 330 to 640, y 400 to 500 has nothing solid. His brothers carry the couch in from the west end of College Ave (x 20, y 450) and set it down here, facing the party house.
